mods.name: Wool & Concrete Stairs & Slabs Backport
mods.description: Server-side backport of 26.3's wool and concrete stairs and slabs to 26.2, via Polymer. Registers them under their native minecraft: ids so they convert seamlessly once 26.3 ships natively. Players only need the auto-served resource pack; no client mod required.
